method: Opened rendered PNGs with view_image and visually inspected equations, tables, plot axes/captions, body text and representative slide layouts.
findings: Readable axes and captions; report tables/equations intact; allocation and viva slides fit their rows; no visible clipping in inspected artifacts. The full report is 9 pages and deck is 14 slides.
limitation: PowerPoint/LibreOffice native renderer unavailable. Slide PNGs come from the explicitly labeled shared-layout PDF; editable PPTX was independently opened and structurally inspected with python-pptx.
